item.title: Error Codes
item.description:
Error Code Reference

Error Codes and Troubleshooting

Meshery and its components use a common framework (defined within MeshKit) to generate and document an event with a unique error code identifier as the combination of [component type]-[component name]-[event moniker]-[numeric code]. Each error code identifies the source component for the error and a standard set of information to describe the error and provide helpful details for troubleshooting the situation surrounding the specific error.

item.title: Meshery Operator CRDs
item.description:
Included in Meshery Operator are a couple of Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and a ConfigMap.

Broker CRD

The CRD is used to configure Broker instances in a cluster.

YAML synopsis

The following section shows a summary of the structure of the Custom Resource and the required fields.

apiVersion: meshery.io/v1alpha1
kind: Broker
metadata:
 name:
 namespace:
 labels:
 app:
 component:
 version:
 annotations:
 meshery/component-type:
spec:
 size:

item.title: Permission Keys
item.description:
Permissions are represented as keys, each serving as a unique identifier for a specific permission. One or more keys can be grouped together and assigned to a keychain.

Customizable Permissions

Default permissions can be easily customized by simply creating your own keychains and roles.

Contributing to Permission Keys

To contribute permission keys, see the Adding a New Permission Key Guide. This guide explains Meshery’s extensible authorization system.
